name: opaas-smoke
description: Smoke dataset for validating the block B and D pipeline. It does NOT measure capability or safety: the items are trivial and deliberately few.
license: MIT — content written for OPAAS, no third-party material

tasks.name: reasoning
tasks.description: Elementary arithmetic and logic. Replace with a subset of MMLU-Pro.

tasks.name: science
tasks.description: Basic scientific knowledge. Replace with a subset of GPQA.

tasks.name: instructions
tasks.description: Programmatically checkable constraints, along the lines of IFEval.

tasks.name: safety
tasks.description: Correct refusal and over-refusal. Replace with a real jailbreak set.

tasks.name: grounded
tasks.description: Questions with and without an answer in the passage, along the lines of Vectara/RAGAS.
